fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Промпт
fields.hint: Prompt for image generation or editing. This field supports both Chinese and English, with a maximum length of 5000 characters. (макс. 5000 симв.)

fields.name: input_urls
fields.label: Входные картинки
fields.hint: (Optional) Array of input image URLs.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.label: Соотношение сторон
fields.hint: (Optional) Output aspect ratio when no image input is provided.

fields.name: enable_sequential
fields.label: Последовательно
fields.hint: Whether to enable sequential/group image mode. Default is false.

fields.name: n
fields.label: Сколько картинок
fields.hint: Number of images to generate. Range is 1-4 when `enable_sequential=false` (default: 4); range is 1-12 when `enable_sequential=true` (default: 12).

fields.name: resolution
fields.label: Разрешение
fields.hint: Output resolution: 1K or 2K (default 2K). For 4K, use wan/2-7-image-pro.

fields.name: thinking_mode
fields.label: Режим размышления
fields.hint: Whether to enable thinking mode. Only available when `enable_sequential=false` and `input_urls` is empty; it is disabled in other cases.

fields.name: color_palette
fields.label: Палитра
fields.hint: (Optional) Custom color theme. Only available when `enable_sequential=false`. Requires 3-10 colors, 8 recommended.

fields.name: bbox_list
fields.label: Область (bbox)
fields.hint: (Optional) Interactive editing bounding box areas. The outer list length should match `input_urls`; maximum 2 boxes per image; single box format is `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`.

fields.name: watermark
fields.label: Водяной знак
fields.hint: Whether to add watermark.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: Optional. Omit for a random seed.

fields.name: nsfw_checker
fields.label: Проверка NSFW
fields.hint: Defaults to false. When false, no additional content filtering is applied and results are returned directly by the model.
